feedback.explanation: The 'Warning Banner' is missing from the render tree. Structural analysis places it at the top of the content (relative top: -157). It must be added as the first child of the ScrollView.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
  <WarningBanner 
    message="⚠️ Cashback may be impacted if delayed further" 
    style={{ width: '100%' }}
  />
</View>
